rules.name: Food Safety Certificate Validity
rules.statement: A Store Partner must not accept new orders unless their food safety certificate is valid and non-expired.
rules.condition: When processing an order request for a specific Store Partner
exceptions: Certificate renewal grace period defined by local law (proposed)
rules.if_violated: The system automatically blocks the order and flags the partner for immediate review
rules.rationale: To prevent the sale of unsafe food and avoid severe regulatory fines and license revocation

parameters.name: certificate_validity_period
parameters.description: Duration for which a certificate remains valid before requiring renewal

rules.name: Labor Law Compliance Verification
rules.statement: A Delivery Partner may only be assigned to a gig-economy task if their labor law compliance status is verified and active.
rules.condition: When allocating a delivery task to a Delivery Partner
exceptions: Emergency override with documented regulatory waiver (proposed)
rules.if_violated: The allocation request is rejected and the partner is suspended pending compliance review
rules.rationale: To mitigate legal liability and ensure adherence to gig-economy labor regulations

parameters.name: compliance_verification_frequency
parameters.description: How often labor compliance status must be re-verified

rules.name: Restricted Zone Service Area Validation
rules.statement: A Service Area Definition must not be created or activated if its geographic boundaries overlap with a zone restricted by the Regulatory Authority.
rules.condition: When creating or modifying a Service Area Definition
exceptions: Manual override by senior compliance officer with written approval (proposed)
rules.if_violated: The system rejects the definition creation or deactivates the area immediately
rules.rationale: To ensure operations strictly adhere to external regulatory geographic restrictions

parameters.name: overlap_tolerance_threshold
parameters.description: Maximum allowable geographic overlap percentage before triggering a block

rules.name: Regulatory Data Update Latency
rules.statement: Regulatory compliance status must be updated within a maximum allowed duration of receiving new data from external sources.
rules.condition: When external regulatory data sources provide updates
exceptions: System downtime or network failure with automatic retry logic (proposed)
rules.if_violated: The system generates a compliance alert and escalates to the operations team for manual intervention
rules.rationale: To ensure real-time accuracy of compliance status and prevent operating on outdated legal information

parameters.name: max_update_latency_hours
parameters.description: Maximum time allowed between receiving external data and updating internal status

rules.name: Proactive Risk Alert Triggering
rules.statement: The system must generate a proactive risk alert when correlated data indicates a high probability of SLA breach or inventory error within the defined prediction window.
rules.condition: when predictive analytics correlate delivery delays, inventory errors, and customer sentiment to indicate imminent brand or SLA risk
exceptions: during scheduled system maintenance windows
when the risk probability falls below the configured threshold
rules.if_violated: the system fails to notify stakeholders of impending operational failures, leading to unmitigated reputational damage and potential order loss
rules.rationale: shifting from reactive to proactive management prevents brand equity erosion before customer dissatisfaction becomes irreversible

parameters.name: prediction_window
parameters.description: time horizon in minutes for forecasting risk events

parameters.name: risk_threshold
parameters.description: minimum probability score required to trigger an alert

rules.name: High-Velocity Inventory Safety Margin
rules.statement: The system must only flag a synchronization discrepancy for high-velocity items when the projected demand exceeds current inventory by the defined safety margin.
rules.condition: when calculating inventory availability for high-velocity products against projected demand
exceptions: during manual inventory adjustment processes
for items explicitly marked as 'non-critical' in the product catalog
rules.if_violated: the system may oversell critical stock or fail to alert on genuine shortages, causing order cancellations and customer churn
rules.rationale: focusing alerts on high-velocity items ensures resources are directed toward preventing the most impactful stockouts

parameters.name: safety_margin
parameters.description: percentage buffer required between projected demand and available stock

rules.name: SLA Breach Notification Deduplication
rules.statement: The system must only send a notification regarding a status change if the new status differs from the status of the most recent notification for that specific transaction.
rules.condition: when processing a status update for an order or refund request
exceptions: when the notification channel has been explicitly overridden by a supervisor
during emergency broadcast scenarios
rules.if_violated: the customer receives redundant or conflicting messages, causing confusion and eroding trust in the platform's communication reliability
rules.rationale: ensures clear, non-repetitive communication to maintain a professional customer experience

parameters.name: notification_frequency_limit
parameters.description: maximum number of status updates allowed per transaction cycle

rules.name: Refund Status Content Integrity
rules.statement: The system must verify that the content of any notification accurately reflects the current state of the Financial Transaction Record before transmission.
rules.condition: when composing a notification message triggered by a refund status change
exceptions: during system rollback procedures initiated by engineering
when the Financial Transaction Record is temporarily locked for audit
rules.if_violated: the customer receives incorrect financial information, leading to disputes, chargebacks, and regulatory compliance issues
rules.rationale: financial accuracy in communications is non-negotiable to prevent disputes and maintain regulatory adherence

parameters.name: validation_latency
parameters.description: maximum time allowed to fetch the latest financial record before sending

rules.name: Jurisdictional Tax Rate Cap
rules.statement: The system must not finalize an Order Request if the calculated tax rate exceeds the maximum threshold defined by the Regulatory Authority.
exceptions: Manual override by Compliance Officer for documented regulatory changes
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is rejected and the customer is notified of the non-compliance risk
rules.rationale: Exceeding statutory tax rates creates immediate legal liability and financial penalties for the platform.

parameters.name: maximum_allowed_tax_rate
parameters.description: The highest tax percentage permitted by local law for the specific jurisdiction

rules.name: Dynamic Tax Jurisdiction Mapping
rules.statement: The system must only apply tax rules corresponding to the precise delivery address jurisdiction, not the store location or user profile.
rules.condition: at the moment of Order Request submission
exceptions: None
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is rejected to prevent incorrect tax collection and regulatory non-compliance
rules.rationale: Tax liability is determined by the location of consumption (delivery), not the origin of the goods.

parameters.name: delivery_jurisdiction_code
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the tax region where the order is delivered

rules.name: Real-Time Tax Rate Synchronization
rules.statement: The system may only calculate taxes using the most current tax rates retrieved from the external tax service at the exact moment of Order Request processing.
exceptions: None
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is rejected to ensure accurate financial settlement and avoid revenue leakage or overcharging
rules.rationale: Tax rates fluctuate frequently; using stale data leads to financial discrepancies and compliance breaches.

parameters.name: tax_rate_refresh_interval
parameters.description: The frequency at which the system queries the external tax service for updates

rules.name: Tax Dispute Auto-Trigger
rules.statement: The system must automatically generate a Dispute Ticket whenever a discrepancy is detected between the calculated tax amount and the amount collected during Financial Transaction Record generation.
exceptions: None
rules.if_violated: A formal dispute record is created to initiate a reconciliation process between the platform and the tax authority
rules.rationale: Automated detection of tax calculation errors ensures rapid remediation and maintains audit integrity.

parameters.name: dispute_threshold_variance
parameters.description: The percentage difference that triggers an automatic dispute ticket

rules.name: Pre-Onboarding License Verification
rules.statement: A Store Partner must not be granted operational access until all required regulatory licenses and food safety certificates are validated as current and authentic.
rules.condition: during the new partner onboarding process
exceptions: None
rules.if_violated: The onboarding process is terminated and the partner is barred from the marketplace until compliance is achieved.
rules.rationale: To prevent legal liability and supply chain disruptions caused by unverified or non-compliant partners.

parameters.name: required_license_types
parameters.description: List of specific licenses mandated by local jurisdiction

rules.name: Agreement Activation Gate
rules.statement: An Order Request may only be allocated to a Store Partner if the associated Partner Agreement is explicitly marked as 'Active' in the system.
rules.condition: when an order is routed to a specific store
exceptions: Emergency manual override by Platform Operator with audit trail
rules.if_violated: The order allocation is rejected and returned to the pool for re-routing.
rules.rationale: To ensure that only partners with valid, active contractual terms can fulfill customer orders.

parameters.name: agreement_status_threshold
parameters.description: The specific status value required to allow allocation

rules.name: License Expiration Warning Threshold
rules.statement: A Store Partner must be notified immediately if their primary operating license expiration date is within a configurable warning period.
rules.condition: when the system detects an upcoming license expiration
exceptions: None
rules.if_violated: The partner's ability to accept new orders is automatically suspended until the license is renewed.
rules.rationale: To mitigate the risk of operating with invalid licenses and facing regulatory fines.

parameters.name: warning_period_days
parameters.description: Number of days before expiration to trigger notification

rules.name: Immutable Agreement Versioning
rules.statement: An amendment to an active Partner Agreement must immediately create a new version number while marking the previous version as historical and read-only.
rules.condition: when a Partner Agreement is amended
exceptions: None
rules.if_violated: The system rejects the amendment request and logs the error for manual review.
rules.rationale: To maintain a complete, non-destructive audit trail of contractual changes for compliance and dispute resolution.

parameters.name: version_increment_rule
parameters.description: Logic determining the next version number
